reports.title: Anglers reported decent fishing
reports.text: Spotted bass were targeted in depths of 10 to 30 feet, with curly-tailed grubs, drop-shot rigs, crankbaits, and even spoons producing bites. Crappie anglers continued to locate fish holding near submerged stumps, stickups, and rock piles, with small live minnows and swimbaits producing good results.

reports.title: Anglers reported plenty of room to fish at Hart Park
reports.text: Bass anglers slowly worked Texas rigs and weedless creature baits along the bottom, resulting in some good catches.

reports.title: Bass fishing at Ming Lake continues to be strong
reports.text: Bass fishing at Ming Lake continues to be strong, with anglers reporting consistent action on 5- and 6-inch Senkos in a variety of colors, particularly green pumpkin. Rattle traps, small jerkbaits, and flukes have also been producing fish, while several larger bass were caught this week on 5- to 7-inch soft-plastic swimbaits.

reports.title: Bass fishing at River Walk remains steady
reports.text: Bass fishing at River Walk remains steady, with anglers finding consistent action on crankbaits, jerkbaits, jigs, and shad-patterned soft plastics fished on drop-shot rigs.

reports.title: Anglers reporting typical winter fishing conditions
reports.text: Bass anglers are finding success with finesse baits in shad, purple, and green pumpkin colors, working them slowly and close to the bottom. Jigs, crankbaits, deep drop-shot presentations, and spoons are key lures for bass anglers, while striped bass anglers can find success trolling, fishing cut baits, and throwing magnum-sized swimbaits and topwater trout imitations.
